name: Contrl
author: contrl

sections.description:
CONTRL is a modern, web-based point-of-sale and e-commerce platform that brings sales, payments, products, and reporting together in one user-friendly solution.

With the CONTRL WordPress plugin, you can easily integrate your CONTRL online store directly into your WordPress website. Simply add a button using the block editor, and your customers can open and browse your online store in a convenient pop-up window, without leaving your website. It is a simple and efficient way to create a seamless shopping experience for your customers.

Features

  • Contrl pop-up block – add the button anywhere in the block editor, on pages, posts or in template parts.
  • Your own store URL – point the block at your CONTRL online store.
  • Custom pop-up title and height – control how the store window is presented on your site.
  • Editable button label – write the button text directly in the editor.
  • Uses the core button styling – the button follows your theme’s button styles, with the usual typography, spacing and alignment controls.
  • Use it more than once – add several buttons on the same page, each with its own settings.
  • Lazy loading – the store is not loaded until a visitor clicks the button, so it does not slow down your pages.

Learn more about CONTRL at contrl.se. The plugin is developed and maintained by Krokedil.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.6 or greater.
  • PHP 7.4 or greater.

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option — WordPress will handle the file transfer, and you won’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of the plugin, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu, and click “Add New.”

In the search field type “Contrl” then click “Search Plugins.” Once you’ve found the plugin, you can install it by clicking “Install Now,” and WordPress will take it from there.

Manual installation

Manual installation method requires downloading the plugin and uploading it to your web server via your favorite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do this here.

Getting started

  1. Activate the plugin.
  2. Edit the page or post where you want the button and insert the Contrl pop-up block.
  3. In the block settings sidebar, enter your CONTRL shop URL. This is required: the button is only shown on your site once a URL is set. Optionally set the pop-up title and height.
  4. Type the button label directly in the block and publish.

Updating

Automatic updates should work smoothly, but we still recommend you back up your site.
sections.faq:
How does the plugin work?

The plugin adds a WordPress block named “Contrl pop-up”. By adding the block a button is displayed on your site. When the visitor clicks the button your CONTRL online store is displayed in a pop-up modal, and the visitor never leaves your website.

Do I need a CONTRL account?

Yes. The plugin displays your existing CONTRL online store, so you need a CONTRL account and the URL of your store. Visit contrl.se to get started with CONTRL.

Can I change the button text and style?

Yes. The button label is edited directly in the block, and the button uses the core WordPress button styling, so it follows your theme and offers the usual typography, spacing and alignment controls.

Can I use the block more than once?

Yes. You can add the Contrl pop-up block several times on the same page, each with its own URL, title and height.

Does the store slow down my site?

No. The store is only loaded when a visitor clicks the button.
sections.changelog:
v1.1.0

  • Feature: The store is lazy loaded, it is only fetched when a visitor clicks the button.
  • Feature: The Contrl pop-up block can be used several times on the same page.
  • Tweak: The shop URL is now required. Blocks without a URL show a warning in the editor and render nothing on the site, instead of opening a store that could not be displayed.
  • Tweak: The pop-up title and button label default to “Shop” on the site, matching what the editor shows.
  • Fix: Load the plugin text domain so translations are applied.
  • Fix: Add type=”button” to the pop-up button.
  • Updated wordpress.org listing: description, screenshots, banner and icons.

v1.0.0

  • Initial release
